note: Signs inferred from rig.json rotSign (+ = clockwise on screen) and part pivots; NOT render-verified (benchmark work parked before screenshots). Body joints clamp to +-1 = +-25 deg (BodyLean 8 deg, HeadTilt 8 deg, HeadNod 6 deg).

MouthForm.note: closed frown at (0,-0.5): nearest-shape pick ties rest/M; no frown drawing

EyeBallX.note: side glance toward her left (sign per eyes rig.json: -1 = her right)

EyeROpen.note: slight lower; lower-lid squint not drawn

NeckTwist.note: 3/4 head turn needs diagonal-view art; skin projection only

ShoulderL.note: arm out to hip: 25 deg cap

ElbowL.note: elbow needs >90 deg; capped at 25 deg, no corrective shape

WristL.note: hand on hip needs 3/4 hand drawing + forearm over torso draw-order override

body_view.note: 3/4 diagonal body pose: diagonals not posable (art acceptance + fit)

outfit.note: bodysuit + heeled sandals: Body owns this layer on skin.json meshes; not built. Dominates any silhouette score.
